summary: Completed comprehensive testing of OnCall Foot Client Booking Lifecycle features. All backend APIs and frontend flows tested successfully with 100% pass rate.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/bookings duplicate-submit protection returns 409 with bookingId
Backend: Different scheduledAt returns 201 (no false positives)
Backend: Different client booking same slot returns 201 (not blocked)
Backend: PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status cancellation without cancellationReason returns 400
Backend: PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status cancellation with cancellationReason returns 200
Backend: Re-booking same slot after cancellation returns 201
Backend: POST /api/reviews for completed booking returns 201
Frontend: Cancel booking dialog is in-app (data-testid='cancel-booking-dialog'), NOT native confirm
Frontend: 'Keep booking' button closes dialog without cancelling
Frontend: 'Cancel booking' confirm button cancels and shows success toast
Frontend: Cancel dialog works from booking detail page /bookings/:id
Frontend: Service selection enables 'Book Appointment' button
Frontend: Duplicate booking via UI shows INFO toast 'already have an active request'
Frontend: Duplicate booking redirects to /bookings without creating duplicate card
Frontend: Completed booking displays saved review instead of form (regression check passed)
